During the [[Orinda campaign]] of [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]], the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] won a '''battle''' in the [[Urce system/Legends|Urce system]]. While the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic's]] [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought/Legends|''Executor''-class Star Dreadnought]] ''[[Lusankya/Legends|Lusankya]]'' was en route to the area in response to a string of Remnant victories, [[Head of State/Legends|Head of State]] [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Gilad Pellaeon]] took his own ''Executor''-class Star Dreadnought, the [[Reaper (Executor-class)|''Reaper'']], to Urce and captured both the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] and a [[HoloNet/Legends|HoloNet]] relay.
